alternatives.option: threading changed-ID deltas out of ingest

context: W2.3 phase 2 implemented: git-HEAD probe on tool dispatch re-ingests records mid-session; schema v2 content_hash; async reconcile re-embeds only changed text. 968 tests + SOAK_SCALE=5 green.
rationale: idempotent and self-healing (records posted while the model was down get embedded later), needs zero ingest plumbing, and the linear scan is fine at the plan's stated ~50k-record ceiling.
summary: Chose a full converge pass (reconcileEmbeddings: orphan delete, NULL-hash backfill, embed missing, re-embed mismatched) over threading changed-ID deltas out of ingest
